continue.description: Default true. false stops Claude entirely after the hook runs, and beats an event-specific decision. It does not by itself block a PreToolUse tool call.

stopReason.description: Shown to the user when continue is false. It stays in the conversation, so Claude sees it later.

systemMessage.description: A warning shown to the user, not added to Claude's context. Capped at 10,000 characters; longer text is saved to a file and replaced by its path and a 2,000 character preview.

terminalSequence.description: A terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook: only OSC 0, 1, 2, 9, 99, 777 and BEL. Anything else makes the field ignored. Interactive sessions only, and not from an async hook.

decision.description: Adds the reason next to the tool result. Claude still sees the original output.

additionalContext.description: Text added to Claude's context next to the tool result, wrapped in a system reminder and not shown as a chat message. State facts rather than give commands. Capped at 10,000 characters.

classifierContext.description: A short note about this result for the auto mode classifier, not for Claude. Capped at 2,000 characters per tool call. Do not copy untrusted tool output into it. Claude Code 2.1.236 or later.

updatedToolOutput.description: Replaces the tool's output before Claude sees it. Must match the tool's output shape, or it is ignored for a built-in tool. Changes only what Claude sees.

updatedMCPToolOutput.description: Replaces the output for MCP tools only. Prefer updatedToolOutput.

title: PostToolUse hook output
description: Gives Claude feedback after a tool ran, or replaces what Claude sees of its output. The tool has already run. Exit code 2 shows stderr to Claude.
